verses.text: So love the LORD your God and always obey his instructions, rules, laws, and commands.

Remember today what you have learned. I am not speaking to your children, who have not known or seen how the LORD your God corrected you. They did not see his greatness, his mighty hand, his powerful arm,
or the miracles and the things he did in Egypt to Pharaoh, king of Egypt, and to his whole land.

They did not see what he did to the Egyptian army, its horses and chariots, how he made the waters of the Red Sea flow over them as they were chasing you. The LORD destroyed them completely, and they are gone to this day.
They did not see what he did for you in the desert until you arrived here,

or what he did to Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, from the tribe of Reuben. In front of all Israel, the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them up, along with their families, their tents, and every living thing that belonged to them.
But you have seen with your own eyes all these great things the LORD has done.
So obey every command I am giving you today, so that you will be strong enough to go in and take over the land you are crossing over to take,
and so that you may live a long time in the land the LORD promised to give your ancestors and their descendants, a land flowing with milk and honey.
The land you are going into to take over is not like Egypt, where you came from. There you planted your seed and had to water it by hand, like a vegetable garden.
But the land you are crossing over to take is a land of hills and valleys that drinks rain from the sky.
It is a land the LORD your God cares for. His eyes are always on it, from the beginning of the year to the end.
If you carefully obey the commands I am giving you today, to love the LORD your God and serve him with all your heart and all your soul,
then he will send rain on your land at the right time, in autumn and in spring, so that you can gather your grain, new wine, and olive oil.
He will give grass in the fields for your animals, and you will have plenty to eat.
Be careful not to be fooled into turning away to serve and worship other gods.

If you do, the LORD's anger will burn against you. He will shut up the sky so there will be no rain, and the land will not produce its crops. Then you will quickly die off the good land the LORD is giving you.
So keep these words of mine in your hearts and minds. Tie them on your hands as a sign, and wear them on your foreheads as a reminder.
Teach them to your children. Talk about them when you are sitting at home and when you are walking along the road, when you lie down and when you get up.
Write them on the doorposts of your houses and on your gates,
so that you and your children may live long in the land the LORD promised to give your ancestors, for as long as the sky is above the earth.
If you carefully obey all these commands I am giving you, to love the LORD your God, to live the way he wants, and to hold tightly to him,
then the LORD will drive out all these nations ahead of you. You will take the land of nations bigger and stronger than you.
Every place where you set your foot will be yours. Your land will reach from the desert to Lebanon, and from the Euphrates River to the Mediterranean Sea.
No one will be able to stand against you. The LORD your God will make all the people in the land terrified of you wherever you go, just as he promised you.
Look, today I am giving you a choice between a blessing and a curse.
You will be blessed if you obey the commands of the LORD your God that I am giving you today.
You will be cursed if you do not obey the commands of the LORD your God, but turn away from the way I am commanding you today and follow other gods you have not known.
When the LORD your God brings you into the land you are going to take over, announce the blessing on Mount Gerizim and the curse on Mount Ebal.
These mountains are west of the Jordan River, toward the setting sun, in the land of the Canaanites who live in the Jordan Valley, near Gilgal, beside the great trees of Moreh.
You are about to cross the Jordan to go in and take over the land the LORD your God is giving you. When you have taken it and are living there,
be careful to obey all the rules and laws I am giving you today.
